name: XlRobustConnect
description: Specifies how the PivotTable cache or a query table connects to its data source.

constants.name: xlAsRequired
constants.description: The PivotTable cache or query table uses external source information to reconnect by using the Connection property.

constants.name: xlAlways
constants.description: The PivotTable cache or query table always uses external source information (as defined by the SourceConnectionFile or SourceDataFile property) to reconnect.

constants.name: xlNever
constants.description: The PivotTable cache or query table never uses source information to reconnect.
